Ni bien me bajé del auto, un prepotente de seguridad se me acerca y me dice que no tenía que entrar tan rápido. Cómo habrá sido de mala la forma y lo poco real del comentario, que un señor con uniforme azul (no era de vigilancia) que estaba detrás mío y escuchó lo que me dijo éste impresentable, me aclaró que la velocidad, como marca en el piso, es de 10km/h. NO INGRESÉ EXCESIVAMENTE RÁPIDO. NO SÉ CÓMO DETERMINAN SI HAY EXCESO DE VELOCIDAD. EL PERSONAL DE SEGURIDAD NO TIENE FACULTADES PARA DETERMINAR ALGO ASÍ, MUCHO MENOS PARA HABLARME DE ESE MODO. SIGAN ASÍ ACA. YA NO CARGO NAFTA PORQUE ATIENDEN EXTREMADAMENTE LENTO. AHORA TAMPOCO VOY MÁS AL FULL GRACIAS A ESTE PERSONAJE IMPRESENTABLE. TODOS LOS EMPLEADOS DE ACA ATIENDEN MAL Y LENTO. LIBERTADOR, CABILDO Y AHORA GODOY CRUZ. SIGAN ASÍ!!!

(Translated by Google)
As soon as I got out of the car, an arrogant security guard approached me and told me I shouldn't have entered so fast. His manner and comment were so untrue that a man in a blue uniform (not a security guard) who was behind me and overheard what this disgraceful individual said clarified that the speed limit, as marked on the ground, is 10 km/h. I DID NOT ENTER EXCESSIVELY FAST. I DON'T KNOW HOW THEY DETERMINE IF SPEED IS EXCESSIVE. SECURITY PERSONNEL HAVE NO AUTHORITY TO DETERMINE SOMETHING LIKE THAT, MUCH LESS TO SPEAK TO ME LIKE THAT. KEEP IT UP HERE. I NO LONGER FILL UP WITH GAS BECAUSE THE SERVICE IS EXTREMELY SLOW. NOW I ALSO STOP FILLING UP THANKS TO THIS DISGRACEFUL CHARACTER. ALL THE EMPLOYEES HERE PROVIDE BAD AND SLOW SERVICE. LIBERTADOR, CABILDO, AND NOW GODOY CRUZ. KEEP IT UP!!!

I would like to congratulate and thank this YPF and ACA representative who so kindly helped me out of the situation I was in.

reviews.comment:
Muy bien ubicada la estación de servicio, accesible para cada calle. Rápido servicio de carga de combustible, personal atento a todo el movimiento de la playa. Un sólo aspecto a mejorar, en el baño de mujeres estaban disponibles solo la mitad de los box de inodoros (3/6), lo que ocasionó hacer cola y esperar muchísimo. La limpieza muy bien.

(Translated by Google)
The gas station is very well located, easily accessible from every street. Fueling was quick, and the staff was attentive to all the activity on the beach. The only thing that could be improved is that only half of the toilet stalls in the women's restroom were available (3/6), which caused a long queue and wait. The cleanliness was excellent.
